newsitem.title: USA: Workforce hires Shulman firm as consultant.
newsitem.headline: Workforce hires Shulman firm as consultant.

text.p: Workforce Systems Corp said Thursday it hired Shulman & Associates Inc as a special financial consultant to help its management develop strategies to improve shareholder value.

Shulman & Associates will provide assistance in identifying, evaluating and structuring of mergers, consolidations, acquisitions, joint ventures and strategic alliances, it said. The firm will also assist and advise Workforce in its financial public relations activities, it said.

Workforce is a small-cap company with subsidiaries involved in manufacturing, marketing and distrubtion and employee staffing services. Workforce is quoted as a Bulletin Board stock in the over-the-counter market. The company said its application for listing of its common stock on the Nasdaq is pending.
